correctness.rationale: For every smooth plane quartic in characteristic !=2, the classical odd-theta interpretation gives the explicitly defined 28-by-63 binary-quadratic incidence matrix. Counting gives \(MM^{\mathsf T}=16I+11J\), so rank 28. The provided pure-Python integer elementary operations construct unimodular U,V and verify \(UMV=\operatorname{diag}(1^{\times7},2^{\times14},4^{\times6},12)\), and independent exact Hermite/Smith routines confirm index \(805306368\). Symplectic transitivity and the exponent 12 show each basis bitangent has exact order 12, independently corroborated by rational Hermite inverses. No infinite claim rests on finite sampling; the geometric-to-matrix identification is the uniform proof.
